candidates.methodFacts: Combine dry ingredients; separately mix wet ingredients, then coat oats. Press in basket on securely food-weighted parchment. Cook10minutes, turn and press, then roughly10minutes more. Cool without disturbing before breaking into clusters.

Publisher calls high-protein but10g per serving is below project default30g; do not carry marketing claim.
